raw:
[
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "astro (Greek astron, star) + world (Old English weorold, age of man); compound = star-age",
    "reading": "The age or domain of the stars; a cosmic epoch where human time yields to celestial time.",
    "languages": ["grc", "en", "ang"],
    "source": "Liddell-Scott Greek-English Lexicon; Bosworth-Toller Anglo-Saxon Dictionary",
    "confidence": 0.85
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "astro + world → as-tro-world; 'as' (like) + 'tro' (trois, three) + 'world' → as-three-world",
    "reading": "A world that is as three — triadic, trinitarian, or triple-layered in its reality.",
    "languages": ["en", "fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "astro (grc star) + world → 'astro' sounds like 'àstro' (Italian 'to star') + 'world' → 'verl' (Dutch for lost)",
    "reading": "A star that is lost; a celestial body gone astray from its orbit.",
    "languages": ["grc", "it", "nl"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.35
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Astroworld → 'world's tar' + 'o' → 'tar' (pitch) + 'world' → 'world's tar'",
    "reading": "The world's tar — a sticky, dark substance binding the earth, a black seal.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "A-S-T-R-O-W-O-R-L-D → A (alpha) S (sigma) T (tau) R (rho) O (omicron) W (double-u) O (omicron) R (rho) L (lambda) D (delta)",
    "reading": "Initials of Greek letters spell a cosmic alphabet: alpha to delta, a star's beginning and end.",
    "languages": ["grc", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "A = first, S = serpent, T = cross, R = sun, O = circle, W = double V, O = circle, R = sun, L = measure, D = door",
    "reading": "First serpent on cross, sun circles, double V, sun, measure, door — a hermetic path.",
    "languages": ["en", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.45
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "A=1, S=19, T=20, R=18, O=15, W=23, O=15, R=18, L=12, D=4 → sum = 145 → 1+4+5=10 → 1",
    "reading": "Reduces to unity — the world of stars collapses to the One, the monad.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "astro (grc) + world (from weorold, 'age' or 'era') → star-era; also 'world' from wer (man) + ald (old) → man-age",
    "reading": "The star-age of man: a time when humanity's fate is written in constellations.",
    "languages": ["grc", "ang"],
    "source": "Bosworth-Toller; Liddell-Scott",
    "confidence": 0.8
  }
]
